findings.title: Researchers Say Claude for Chrome Flaw Lets Rogue Extensions Trigger Gmail Reads
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News reported on July 14, 2026 that Manifold Security disclosed a flaw in Claude for Chrome v1.0.80 letting any other extension able to run a script on claude.ai trigger Gmail, Docs, and Calendar tasks through a forged click. Manifold reported both issues to Anthropic on May 21 against v1.0.72; Anthropic acknowledged them the next day and closed both, and the vulnerable click handler remained byte-for-byte identical in v1.0.80 as of July 7. The flaw rates CVSS 7.7 High in default mode and 9.6 Critical with hands-off automation enabled, and no patch had shipped as of publication.
